categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Universal Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the life sciences sector, focusing on life science reagents centered around antibodies, related instruments, consumables, and comprehensive technical services. The company offers a one-stop platform integrating over 60 well-known third-party brands and its own brands such as Absin, LabEx, STARTER, and UA, covering a wide range of research fields including genetics, protein, cell, tissue, and animal studies. It serves higher education institutions, research institutes, hospitals, and biopharmaceutical companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced biotechnology techniques including antibody production, protein expression, purification, and labeling technologies. It uses both self-production and ODM (Original Design Manufacturer) models for manufacturing, with specialized processes such as freeze-drying, centrifugation, and immunoreactions. The company also integrates digital platforms like ERP, OMS, WMS, and LIMS to optimize supply chain, order management, and laboratory information management, enhancing production and service efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 90 top Chinese universities (985 and 211 projects), more than 450 research institutes under the Chinese Academy of Sciences and other systems, nearly 500 top-tier hospitals, and over 50 listed biopharmaceutical companies domestically and internationally. The markets served span academic research, medical research, in vitro diagnostics, drug development, and cell therapy research.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with extensive sales and service networks covering major regions through 11 sales subsidiaries and 18 offices nationwide. It also has a small but growing overseas presence through subsidiaries and export activities, with overseas revenue accounting for less than 1% of total revenue. Key operational bases include Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou, and other major Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Universal Biotech functions mainly as a midstream and downstream player in the life sciences supply chain. It acts as a comprehensive distributor and service provider, integrating upstream third-party reagent manufacturers and its own production capabilities to supply end customers. The company manages procurement, warehousing, logistics, and distribution, supported by a digitalized and intelligent supply chain system.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include enhancing its one-stop life science service platform and excelling in antibody technology. It focuses on expanding product lines, increasing R&D investment particularly in antibodies, proteins, and diagnostic reagents, and accelerating digital transformation of its platforms and supply chain. The company also pursues external growth via mergers, acquisitions, and partnerships to strengthen its market position and product offerings.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the wholesale and direct sales of life science reagents, instruments, consumables, and comprehensive technical services. The company operates a hybrid sales model combining direct sales (about 80% of revenue) and distribution channels, supported by an e-commerce platform for online orders. It also earns income from experimental services and customized product solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a market dominated by international giants such as Merck, Thermo Fisher, Danaher, and Avantor, which hold the majority of high-end reagent market share in China. Domestically, it is one of the leading comprehensive suppliers with a strong brand presence as the 'Antibody Expert' and a broad product portfolio. It faces competition from specialized product companies, numerous regional distributors, and foreign multinational corporations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a decrease of 8.82% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.15 million, down 74.83%. Despite recent revenue and profit declines, the company has steadily increased R&D investment, reaching 5.62% of revenue in 2024. It maintains a solid asset base of over RMB 2.3 billion and has a workforce of 655 employees, including a significant proportion of highly educated technical staff.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Universal Biotech emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop platform integrating a vast SKU range exceeding 9.7 million products, combining third-party and proprietary brands to meet diverse research needs. Its competitive advantages include specialized antibody expertise, extensive technical support throughout the sales process, a robust digital supply chain ensuring product quality and traceability, and a strong customer base across academia, healthcare, and biopharma sectors. The company’s focus on innovation, quality, and service aims to enhance customer research efficiency and reliability.
